messages:
Laura Chen: Quick heads up — scheduled maintenance tonight 23:00–23:45 UTC for an urgent certificate rotation on the control-plane. We expect the serving runtime to stay online but there may be short reconnects for the Console and dashboard (~15–30s). Might need an extra 10–15m if the rollout hits a bad host.

Shawn Patel: Noted. Which services are in-scope? Any dedicated-customer routing changes we should prep?

Laura Chen: In-scope: control-plane API and the auth-proxy. Serving nodes (inference) are NOT in scope. Dedicated customers: routing stays the same; if anyone reports impact we escalate to an advisory call. No token rotation required.

Maria Gomez: I'll draft the statuspage copy and a short customer email. Do we want explicit SLO mention?

Laura Chen: Yes — say "no expected request loss; transient reconnects possible up to ~30s". Call out dedicated customers get a heads-up and a direct contact link. Keep it short.

Incident Bot: Scheduled maintenance created — ID: MAINT-2026-0423-1. Notifying oncall 30m before window.

Eli Rodgers (Oncall Pager): I'm oncall for that window, taking the pager. @Laura please attach the rollback runbook and any special monitoring thresholds.

Laura Chen: Runbook snippet (paste):
```
# Cert rotation rollback quick steps
1) If cert deployment fails, abort rollout: `kubectl rollout undo -n redwood controlplane-deploy`
2) Repoint proxy if needed: `kubectl apply -f auth-proxy-prev-secret.yaml`
3) Monitor: `promql: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="control-plane",code!~"2.."}[1m]))`
4) If 5xx > 0.5% for >2m escalate to P1 and call infra lead.
```

Eli Rodgers: Got it. Recommend we do a 5% canary first to limit blast radius.

Shawn Patel: Agree. I'll push the canary at +5m then full at +15m if canary healthy. Infra commands: `helm upgrade --set image.tag=cert-rotate-canary ...` then promote.

Maria Gomez: Draft statuspage copy: 
```
- 23:00 UTC — Maintenance started: rotating control-plane certificates (MAINT-2026-0423-1).
- Expected impact: transient reconnects to Console/dashboard (<=30s). Serving API should remain available.
- Updates: will post as we progress; customers can subscribe to updates.
```
Also drafting customer email: 
```
Subject: Planned maintenance (control-plane certificates) — 23:00 UTC today
Hi — we will rotate control-plane certificates tonight. You may notice brief reconnects to the Console/dashboard (~<30s). No action required. Contact support@redwood.com if you see issues.
```

Customer Comms: LGTM. Please add link to support and a note that we'll post a follow-up if anything unexpected occurs.

Oncall Pager: Escalation rule for the window: if 5xx rate >0.5% for 2 consecutive minutes or sustained error spike for 5m, escalate to P1.

Laura Chen: Agreed. If we hit that, change statuspage state to "Investigating" and ping #incidents.

Incident Bot: MAINT-2026-0423-1 STARTED at 23:01 UTC.

Eli Rodgers: Starting canary now (5% traffic). Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/s/controlplane

Shawn Patel: Canary healthy at 23:05 after 3m. Promoting to full rollout. :thumbsup:

Eli Rodgers: Rolling out full at 23:07. Monitoring for 5xx/latency.

Shawn Patel: Full rollout finished at 23:12. No elevated errors observed. Marking as "verifying".

Incident Bot: MAINT-2026-0423-1 COMPLETED at 23:18 UTC.

Laura Chen: Final update: certs rotated successfully, control-plane stable. No customer-facing errors beyond short reconnects. Posting completion note on status page and sending follow-up email.

Customer Comms: Posted status page update and sent customer email at 23:25 UTC. :tada:

Maria Gomez: Follow-ups: (1) add canary thresholds to runbook, (2) add monitoring alert to reduce noisy false positives, (3) schedule a short retro to capture lessons. Filing tickets now.

Eli Rodgers: Closing the pager. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
